SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar
WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 5

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  s.format,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipts,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-08-25' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-09-21'
AND f.channel_code = 'ST'  -- store sales only, not web
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format
ORDER BY net_sales DESC

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(f.net_amount) DESC) as rank,
  s.store_id,
  s.store_name,
  s.region,
  s.format,
  SUM(f.net_amount) as net_sales,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) as receipts,
  SUM(f.quantity) as units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
INNER JOIN dim_store s ON f.store_key = s.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date >= '2025-08-25' AND f.sale_date <= '2025-09-21'
AND f.channel_code = 'ST'  -- store sales only, not web
AND s.store_id < 900  -- exclude training and non-operational stores
GROUP BY s.store_id, s.store_name, s.region, s.format
ORDER BY net_sales DESC
